info.description: Clean tabular data for LLM pipelines in one call: strip zero-width and invisible Unicode characters, normalize whitespace, drop empty rows, and return a Markdown table. Values are kept as strings, not parsed to numbers: "$1,299.00" stays "$1,299.00". Requires a RapidAPI subscription key (free tier: 200 requests/month); set the apiKey variable to your RapidAPI key. Request shape follows the verified OpenAPI v2 spec; a live gateway call has not yet been tested (needs a RapidAPI key). Local browser demo, no key needed: https://seanxin126.github.io/token-cost-optimizer/demo/cleandata/
info.name: CleanData for AI Agents
